description: Explicit demo-only input recipes using repository example fixtures and selected property record IDs. See README before using records in a live request.

cases.title: BASS-II opposed-flow PMMA sheet at 0.20 mm
cases.notes: The flame coefficient was fitted at 0.10 mm. The 0.20 and 0.30 mm comparisons are approximate figure reads and individual flow speeds are unspecified.

cases.title: Saffire II SIBAL concurrent spread at 22.5 cm/s
cases.notes: Limiting rate is anchored to II-5 and compared with II-6 at 25 cm/s. Sample positions differ; the transient and flux assumptions are illustrative.

cases.title: FLEX-002 methanol regression to visible extinction diameter
cases.notes: The time uses reported igniter-on diameter, visible-endpoint diameter and fitted regression. Nominal temperature is a placeholder unused in measured mode. NASA reports a 5 s burn time.

cases.title: FLEX R377 hot and cool stages
cases.notes: R377 itself supplies the cool-extinction reference. This reconstructs the calibration case.

cases.title: BASS-II pooled PMMA rod fit at 2 cm/s
cases.notes: The model evaluates the published curve with the 3.18 mm radius conversion at nominal pressure. Earth comparator is a different configuration.

cases.title: Methanol and water surface snapshot at 25 °C
cases.notes: Uses the bundled 50/50 liquid and 2 kPa ambient water with an explicit ideal-mixture assumption. Transfer conductances are absent; the example returns direction and null rate.

/evidence/provenance/notes: Illustrative 50/50 mixture, unit activity coefficients and ambient water partial pressure; pure-component data are evaluated at the reference temperature. Snapshot without a mass-transfer coefficient.

/evidence/sources.locator: Marchese and Dryer, The effect of liquid mass transport on the combustion and extinction of bicomponent droplets of methanol and water

cases.title: CO₂ dilution at 300–400 K
cases.notes: Added CO₂ is 30% of the final mixture. The base gas is 21% O₂ and 79% N₂. Heat capacity fits use the source values evaluated at 300 and 400 K. This is a thermal budget.

/evidence/provenance/notes: Illustrative dilution scenario. The Cp linearizations use NIST Shomate values at 300 and 400 K.

cases.title: Water-mist budget using the 100 °C saturation row
cases.notes: 0.25 kg water heated from 20 to 100 °C with an assumed 50% evaporation. Pressure is the 100 °C saturation pressure rounded to the table precision. This budget excludes delivery and extinction.

/evidence/provenance/notes: Illustrative water mass and assumed evaporation fraction. Water enthalpy budget uses NISTIR 5078, Table 1 saturation rows at 20 and 100 °C.
